# Journal of Medical Internet Research

> > JMIR is a leading open-access publisher of peer-reviewed journals focused on digital health, eHealth, medical informatics, and health technology innovation.

JMIR Publications operates a portfolio of 20+ specialized open-access journals covering digital health, telemedicine, AI in healthcare, medical education, and disease-specific research. All journals are indexed in major databases including PubMed, PubMed Central, Scopus, and Web of Science, with strong impact factors and CiteScores.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-reviewed journals
- digital health
- telemedicine
- medical informatics
- health technology
- eHealth
- wearable technology
- artificial intelligence in healthcare
- health data analytics
- medical education
- health interventions
- patient safety
- public health surveillance
- mobile health (mHealth)

## Flagship & Core Journals

- [Journal of Medical Internet Research](https://jmir.org): Main flagship peer-reviewed journal on digital health and eHealth research
- [JMIR AI](https://ai.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed open-access journal on health AI, medical informatics, and biomedical research
- [JMIR mHealth and uHealth](https://mhealth.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal on mobile health, wearables, and ubiquitous computing
- [JMIR Mental Health](https://mental.jmir.org): Open-access journal on digital mental health, internet interventions, and AI psychiatry
- [JMIR Medical Informatics](https://medinform.jmir.org): Open-access journal on clinical informatics, EHRs, and health data analytics

## Public Health & Epidemiology Journals

- [JMIR Public Health and Surveillance](https://publichealth.jmir.org): Open-access journal for public health, surveillance systems, and digital epidemiology
- [Online Journal of Public Health Informatics](https://ojphi.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed open-access journal for public health informatics research

## Clinical Specialty Journals

- [JMIR Cardio](https://cardio.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on cardiology, telemedicine, and digital health
- [JMIR Diabetes](https://diabetes.jmir.org): Open-access journal on diabetes digital health, wearables, and patient self-management
- [JMIR Cancer](https://cancer.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed journal on cancer research, survivorship, and digital health innovation
- [JMIR Dermatology](https://derma.jmir.org): Open-access journal on dermatology, teledermatology, and digital health innovations
- [JMIR Pediatrics and Parenting](https://pediatrics.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on pediatric health and parenting technologies

## Health Systems & Implementation Journals

- [JMIR Formative Research](https://formative.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed open-access journal for formative and feasibility health research
- [JMIR Human Factors](https://humanfactors.jmir.org): Medical journal on human factors, usability, patient safety, and healthcare design
- [JMIR Rehabilitation and Assistive Technologies](https://rehab.jmir.org): Peer-reviewed open-access journal on rehabilitation and assistive technologies

## Education & Learning Journals

- [JMIR Medical Education](https://mededu.jmir.org): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on medical education and e-learning
- [JMIR Serious Games](https://games.jmir.org): Academic journal on serious games, gamification, and game-based health education

## Emerging & Special Initiatives

- [JMIR Aging](https://aging.jmir.org): Open-access journal on digital health, gerontology, and older adults
- [JMIRx Med](https://xmed.jmir.org): Overlay journal for preprint publishing and open peer review of medical research

- [JMIR Publications Career Center](https://careers.jmir.org): Job listings and career opportunities at JMIR Publications
